description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application runtime from Java 8 and Spring Boot 2.7.18 to Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.x to satisfy the organisation's target-platform policy and enable all downstream Azure service migrations.
tasks.reason: Java 8, 11, and 17 are end-of-life for internal use per the organisational policy. Spring Boot 2.x must be upgraded. Java 25 is the organisational target LTS version and Spring Boot 4.x is required for Java 25 compatibility.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the project from Java 8 to Java 25 and from Spring Boot 2.7.18 to Spring Boot 4.x. Ensure all dependencies are compatible with the new versions. The upgrade includes Spring Framework 5.x to 7.x migration and the Jakarta EE namespace migration (javax.* to jakarta.*).

tasks.description: Replace the three on-premises RabbitMQ AMQP queue consumers with Azure Service Bus, using managed identity for passwordless authentication.
tasks.reason: RabbitMQ is an on-premises message broker targeted for retirement. Azure Service Bus is the organisation's mandated managed messaging service. Managed identity eliminates credential management overhead and aligns with the service-to-service authentication policy.
tasks.requirements: Migrate all three RabbitMQ AMQP queue consumers (order.created, inventory.alert, approval.pending) to Azure Service Bus. Use managed identity for authentication. Remove Spring AMQP / RabbitMQ dependencies and replace with the Azure Service Bus messaging integration. Update all message listener annotations and connection configuration.

tasks.description: Remove all hardcoded credentials from source code and configuration files, storing them in Azure Key Vault and retrieving them at runtime via managed identity.
tasks.reason: Hardcoded credentials in application.yml (RabbitMQ username/password) violate the organisational security policy. Azure Key Vault is the mandatory secrets store for all sensitive values, and access must be granted via managed identity.
tasks.requirements: Identify and migrate all hardcoded sensitive values (credentials, connection strings, API keys) from application.yml and source code to Azure Key Vault. Configure the application to retrieve secrets from Azure Key Vault at runtime using managed identity. Remove any plaintext credentials from all configuration files.

tasks.description: Replace all SLF4J logger usages and System.out.println / System.err.println calls with InternalLogger to comply with the organisational logging standard.
tasks.reason: SLF4J, Logback, and System.out.println are prohibited logging mechanisms per the organisational policy because they lack trace-context integration. InternalLogger (com.acme.logging.InternalLogger) injects trace IDs, team tags, and structured JSON, which is mandatory for all modernised applications.
tasks.requirements: Replace all @Slf4j / LoggerFactory-based logging calls and System.out.println / System.err.println statements throughout the codebase with InternalLogger (com.acme.logging.InternalLogger). Remove the Logback/SLF4J dependencies from pom.xml and add the InternalLogger dependency. Update all log call sites to use the InternalLogger API.

tasks.description: Replace try/catch blocks used for business-logic flow control with the Result<T> pattern in compliance with the P0-2024-0847 post-incident mandate.
tasks.reason: The organisational policy (P0-2024-0847 post-incident mandate) explicitly prohibits using exceptions and try/catch blocks for business-logic flow control. The Result<T> pattern (com.acme.commons.Result) is the approved alternative for all error-handling in application code.
tasks.requirements: Identify all try/catch blocks used for business-logic flow control in the codebase, including those in OrderMessageListener. Replace them with the Result<T> pattern using com.acme.commons.Result. Add the required dependency for com.acme.commons.Result to pom.xml. Ensure all message handler methods return or propagate Result<T> appropriately.

tasks.description: Create a multi-stage Dockerfile using the approved Java 25 build and distroless runtime base images, producing a minimal container image ready for Azure Container Apps deployment.
tasks.reason: The application must be containerised before it can be deployed to Azure Container Apps. Using a distroless runtime image minimises the attack surface and reduces image size per the organisational container image policy.
tasks.requirements: Create a multi-stage Dockerfile: use mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-ubuntu for the build stage and mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-distroless for the runtime stage. The image must copy the Spring Boot fat JAR from the build stage and set the appropriate entry point. Expose the application port defined in application.yml.

tasks.description: Provision all required Azure resources using Bicep IaC and deploy the containerised SupplyChain Worker to Azure Container Apps, connecting to Azure Service Bus and Azure Key Vault via managed identity.
tasks.reason: Azure Container Apps is the organisation's default target compute platform for all Java services in the supply chain system. Managed identity is required for all service-to-service authentication per the organisational policy.
tasks.requirements: Generate Bicep IaC files for all required Azure resources (Azure Container Apps environment, Azure Service Bus namespace, Azure Key Vault, managed identity). Deploy the containerised application to Azure Container Apps. Configure managed identity bindings to grant access to Azure Service Bus and Azure Key Vault.
